subtopic: Best Interest Obligations and Conflicts of Interest
source_evidence: At the same time, the way advisers make money creates some conflicts with your interests.
question: Misconception: Because investment advisers must act in their clients’ best interest, conflicts of interest cannot affect their advice.
answer: An adviser’s obligation to act in your best interest does not mean conflicts are absent. The source says the way advisers are paid can create conflicts that may affect their advice, so you should understand and ask about those conflicts.
